findings.label: Reasoning and task understanding
findings.missing_runtime_behavior: The normal operator read model is not the exact executable founder mission entry point.
findings.authority_safety_risk: A model-assisted interpretation must never mint approval or request authority.
findings.operator_impact: Operators cannot yet carry one assessed intent directly into the proven exact mission lane.
findings.proposed_uaa_native_implementation: Use the existing exact founder mission surface and keep typed facts, assumptions, unknowns, and questions visible.

findings.label: Planning and orchestration
findings.missing_runtime_behavior: Arbitrary goals do not receive runtime-generated plans and after-start cancellation stays bounded.
findings.authority_safety_risk: Broader planning must not bypass immutable plan or exact dispatch bindings.
findings.operator_impact: Useful mission breadth is narrower than GoatCitadel.
findings.proposed_uaa_native_implementation: Promote only exact predeclared plans and retain dispatcher re-evaluation for every step.

findings.label: Learning and adaptation
findings.missing_runtime_behavior: Adaptation is governed metadata feedback rather than demonstrated longitudinal improvement.
findings.authority_safety_risk: Automatic preference inference could silently promote recall to truth.
findings.operator_impact: Quality changes are reviewable but not yet measured over repeated use.
findings.proposed_uaa_native_implementation: Measure accepted and corrected memory feedback with repeatable retrieval-quality scenarios.

findings.label: Memory and context management
findings.missing_runtime_behavior: The safe FTS projection has no demonstrated query consumer and context remains preview-only.
findings.authority_safety_risk: Context materialization must not become hidden injection or action authority.
findings.operator_impact: UAA has stronger governance but narrower usable recall.
findings.proposed_uaa_native_implementation: Add bounded lexical retrieval over safe projections in a later focused memory slice.

findings.label: Communication and interaction
findings.missing_runtime_behavior: UAA proves content-free handoffs, not a broad conversational model experience.
findings.authority_safety_risk: Messages and model output must remain data rather than authority.
findings.operator_impact: The operator path is less fluid than GoatCitadel Unified Work.
findings.proposed_uaa_native_implementation: Adapt GoatCitadel's readable mode posture while keeping backend intent truth and exact leases.

findings.label: Action and tool calling
findings.missing_runtime_behavior: Exact useful lanes work, while the generic tool registry remains intentionally non-callable.
findings.authority_safety_risk: A global callable registry would expand authority and replay attack surface.
findings.operator_impact: UAA is safer but exposes fewer useful tools.
findings.proposed_uaa_native_implementation: Promote individually proven adapters through the dispatcher only.

findings.label: Autonomy and authority
findings.missing_runtime_behavior: Production and public authority remain explicitly outside scope.
findings.authority_safety_risk: Wildcard grants and approval bypass would violate UAA's exact request boundary.
findings.operator_impact: UAA trades breadth for stronger assurance.
findings.proposed_uaa_native_implementation: Retain deny-unknown and immediately re-evaluate every exact start.

findings.label: Code and implementation assistance
findings.missing_runtime_behavior: Main does not yet contain the separately proven sealed calculation adapter or exact patch-apply lane.
findings.authority_safety_risk: Trusted host execution cannot substitute for sealed isolation.
findings.operator_impact: GoatCitadel currently offers a broader coding workflow.
findings.proposed_uaa_native_implementation: Land the preserved sealed-adapter PR, then add hash-bound proposal and exact apply as separate lanes.

findings.label: Research and external information
findings.missing_runtime_behavior: Authenticated browsing, browser actions, and paid use remain denied.
findings.authority_safety_risk: Fetched content must never become instruction or action authority.
findings.operator_impact: UAA already leads on governed bounded research but has less browser breadth.
findings.proposed_uaa_native_implementation: Preserve SearXNG and Firecrawl self-host-first behavior and cited untrusted aggregation.

findings.label: Model and provider management
findings.missing_runtime_behavior: Configured multi-provider routing breadth and live comparative cost evidence are limited.
findings.authority_safety_risk: Unknown readiness or budget must fail closed and provider output cannot grant authority.
findings.operator_impact: Provider selection is less flexible than GoatCitadel.
findings.proposed_uaa_native_implementation: Add one exact configured provider lane with settlement before broad routing.

findings.label: Evidence, audit, and observability
findings.missing_runtime_behavior: Cross-repository empirical task performance and observed usability are not measured.
findings.authority_safety_risk: Scores must not become authority or conceal false completion.
findings.operator_impact: Operators lacked one metric-bearing view of completion, recovery, evidence, and policy violations.
findings.proposed_uaa_native_implementation: Run a bounded content-free evaluation across all 16 components and label cross-repo performance not measured.

findings.label: Safety, security, and failure handling
findings.missing_runtime_behavior: Public distribution and production operations remain outside evidence.
findings.authority_safety_risk: Failures must never be converted into completion or silently swallowed.
findings.operator_impact: UAA leads on exact failure truth but is not production-certified.
findings.proposed_uaa_native_implementation: Keep atomic denial, recovery-required states, redaction, and kill-switch proof mandatory.

findings.label: UX implementation as an AI cockpit
findings.missing_runtime_behavior: Exact founder mission execution is not yet reachable from the current cockpit.
findings.authority_safety_risk: React controls cannot mint or cache authority.
findings.operator_impact: GoatCitadel presents a more complete operator workflow today.
findings.proposed_uaa_native_implementation: Adapt readable approval and run-detail presentation after the exact backend PR lands.

findings.label: CLI and API parity
findings.missing_runtime_behavior: Some mutations remain intentionally absent rather than falsely mirrored.
findings.authority_safety_risk: No surface may bypass Python authority contracts.
findings.operator_impact: UAA leads on systematic parity and route classification.
findings.proposed_uaa_native_implementation: Keep human-readable CLI primary and add routes only for real backend capabilities.

findings.label: Extensibility and ecosystem
findings.missing_runtime_behavior: UAA has no controlled reference scenario spanning the inspectable non-callable contract.
findings.authority_safety_risk: Inspectable metadata must never imply callable runtime authority.
findings.operator_impact: GoatCitadel offers a broader developer ecosystem.
findings.proposed_uaa_native_implementation: Add a deterministic non-callable extension scenario without enabling runtime import.

findings.label: Productized agent loop
findings.missing_runtime_behavior: The proven founder filesystem mission is not wired to a protected operator mutation surface on current main.
findings.authority_safety_risk: The UI cannot manufacture approval, leases, targets, or completion.
findings.operator_impact: This is UAA's largest current product-usefulness gap.
findings.proposed_uaa_native_implementation: Land PR 272's exact prepare, approve, execute, receipt, and memory-candidate path before adding broader workflows.
